mostWorthwhile.text: Combining pyruvate and ATP with oxygen was most worthwhile: the planned illustration separates fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and connects hydrogen-ion movement through ATP synthase to ATP renewal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the glucose carrier was predictable setup, though it made the later transport sequence possible.

surprise.text: The compatibility list showed that pyruvate and ATP could combine directly with oxygen even though no mitochondrion was selectable; the result then placed the aerobic reactions in the mitochondrion.

arbitrary.text: Using the combined item ‘Pyruvate and ATP’ with amino acids for protein synthesis felt somewhat arbitrary: the explanation gives ATP a role but does not connect pyruvate to that construction.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: contrasting passive channels with the ATP-powered pump made the constructions useful for understanding how cellular structures work together. These are judgments of the supplied plans, not evidence of student comprehension.
